messages:
elaine: quick FYI ran AWQ(INT8) + continuous-batching + prefix-cache bake on squad-style eval. seeing ~3.2% F1 delta vs fp8 baseline and cache hitrate down ~13% after switching quant variant. attaching quick logs and numbers. :frowning:

raj: can you paste the kv key format? seems like a cache key mismatch we saw before.

elaine: here's a short snippet of the cache key and one of the log lines:
```
KVCACHE: key=prefix::model=gpt-7b-awq-int8::seqhash=0x9ab2::ctxlen=128
KVCACHE: hit=false reason=key-not-found variant=awq-int8
INFER: batch_id=3245 model=fp8-v2 -> latency=42ms tokens=120
INFER: batch_id=3246 model=awq-int8 -> latency=38ms tokens=120
```

taylor: hmm looks like the `variant` field isn't part of the canonical key in our prefix cache implementation. continuous batching merges requests and reuses keys across model variants -> stale/missed entries.

sasha: +1. this is the same class of bug where prefetch populated cache with model A format and model B requests looked up without model hash. short-term: add model_variant_hash to key. longer-term: cache versioning and invalidation when kernel/layout changes. :bulb:

jen: suggestion for minimal experiment: run two controlled runs, keep everything identical except cache key v1 vs v2. command: `bench/runner --suite=squad-smoke --model=awq-int8 --batch-window=10ms --cache-key=varianted` then flip `--cache-key=legacy` for comparison. tag results with exp=kv-key-variant-1719004321.

raj: also try disabling prefetch for AWQ model only, see if hitrate recovers. prefetch can poison cache when layout differs.

elaine: good plan. i'll queue two runs now (exp ids: 202603-11-01-A, 202603-11-01-B). will post metrics when done.

bench-bot: exp 202603-11-01-A started (model=awq-int8, batch_window=10ms, cache_key=varianted). ETA ~8m.

jen: if we confirm cache-key fix, we should add a small migration: bump cache namespace `kvcache:v2` and make rollout toggle in runtime flags. keeps old entries aside.

raj: low risk. also add unit test that simulates continuous-batching merging and asserts keys include model hash.

elaine: thanks. pinging @sasha and @jen for PR follow-up. I'll post the bench outputs when exp completes.

sasha: linking a related PR for reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1123 -- has prototype cache-version header.

bench-bot: exp 202603-11-01-A completed: f1=0.781, hitrate=62% -> compared to baseline fp8 f1=0.806, hitrate=75%. detailed logs uploaded to /bench/202603-11-01-A/logs.tar.gz

elaine: OK that's consistent with initial number. moving to run B now with `cache_key=legacy` vs `varianted` comparison.

raj: nice, once B completes we can decide whether to ship cache-key change + rollout gate. also run a short canary to verify latency/regressions.

elaine: will do. :thumbsup:
